name: Takuma Masuda
bio: Takuma is an intern from Japan, and an undergraduate student at the University of Electro-Communications. He is pursuing a Bachelor's degree in the Media Science and Engineering Program (Cluster I, Informatics and Computer Engineering). His primary focus at the lab involves Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), and Extended Reality(XR), with a broader interest in integrating these immersive technologies into our daily lives to enhance human wellbeing. In his free time, he enjoys watching anime and exploring different foods and places.
